# polaris_semantic_model (Resource)

Manages a Polaris semantic model: an [Apache Ossie](https://github.com/apache/ossie) document stored in a namespace. Requires the `ENABLE_SEMANTIC_MODELS` feature on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polaris_semantic_model" "revenue" {
  catalog      = "lakehouse"
  namespace    = ["sales"]
  name         = "revenue"
  spec_version = "0.2.0.dev0"

  # An Apache Ossie semantic model. Each dataset source must be an existing
  # table or view of the catalog, written <namespace>.<table>.
  document = jsonencode({
    name        = "revenue"
    description = "Revenue analytics"
    datasets = [{
      name        = "orders"
      source      = "sales.orders"
      primary_key = ["order_id"]
    }]
    metrics = [{
      name = "total_revenue"
      expression = {
        dialects = [{ dialect = "ANSI_SQL", expression = "SUM(amount)" }]
      }
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) The name of the catalog. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `document` (String) The Ossie semantic model, a JSON object (use `jsonencode`). It must have a `datasets` array, and each dataset `source` must name an existing table or view of the catalog as `<namespace>.<table>`. Polaris stores it as written.
- `name` (String) The name of the semantic model: letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `namespace` (List of String) Namespace the semantic model is stored in, as an ordered list of levels. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `spec_version` (String) The Apache Ossie spec version the document follows, e.g. `0.2.0.dev0`.

### Read-Only

- `entity_version` (String) Opaque version of the semantic model, changed by every update and used for optimistic concurrency.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a semantic model by catalog, namespace path and name, separated by "/".
terraform import polaris_semantic_model.revenue lakehouse/sales/revenue
```
